notes.title: Offical Release -- Devil Slot Machine
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are thrilled to announce that Devil Slot Machine is now officially available on Steam with a launch discount of -25%. This is a truly exciting moment for all of us!

Devil Slot Machine is a Roguelike Tower Defense game where demons will fall like pinballs from the top of the machine. You must buy various chips to serve as defensive towers, combining different strategies to build their defenses and unleash elemental bullets to destroy enemies.

[h2]In the offical release version, you can experience:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 4 characters, each with their own attack styles and quest

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751365/70bb56f9be209033a9810f795acf6232c40b9966.gif[/img]

[*] 4 stages, each featuring unique mechanics and challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751365/d8f7fb96cc6f1e10b64febdf90220d3611ec6919.gif[/img]

[*] 80 types of towers. Use combinations of elements and mechanics to make your own build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751365/213851fbd5afe693d7496ab08d657c351677f867.jpg[/img]
[h3][u]A Message from the Development Team: [/u][/h3]

Hello everyone, I’m the designer of Devil Slot Machine, and I’m thrilled that after nearly a year and a half of development, our game is finally out!

At the start of the project, all of our team members were still university students. Our shared passion for games and dreams of being creators brought us together, and Devil Slot Machine was originally created for the China University Student Game Awards (CUSGA). Fortunately, Devil Slot Machine was well-received at the competition, inspiring us to continue development and launch the game on Steam.

Over the past year, many changes have occurred within our team. Several members have graduated and entered the game industry they once dreamed of. Although we’ve become full-time workers, every member was still willing to dedicate their spare time to continue developing this game. I’m deeply touched by this and made a promise to ensure Devil Slot Machine would be released.

Now, I’ve fulfilled that promise! Although there are some features we couldn’t finish before launch, I believe we’ve made something truly enjoyable, and I hope players will love it.

Devil Slot Machine is far from the end for us. As long as we continue to cherish our love for games, we’ll have future projects that will bring us back together, no matter where we are. Passion is the strongest bond between creators.

Finally, thank you to every team member for your hard work and dedication to this project. And a heartfelt thanks to all the players for supporting and enjoying our game—your passion is our greatest motivation for creating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751365/6c594b8c4a2c717d5cddec1f5cebdce1a7de4480.gif[/img]

See you on the pinball table! Don’t forget to join our Discord and share your feedback with us.

notes.title: Devil Slot Machine Official Release on October 24
notes.content:
The roguelike tower defense game [b]Devil Slot Machine[/b] is set to officially launch on Steam on October 24!

Watch the release trailer: [previewyoutube=E3Cf3BFSUmE;full]https://youtu.be/E3Cf3BFSUmE[/previewyoutube]

After months of development, the official release version will be significantly different from the previous one!

[h2]In the official version:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The monster spawning mechanism has been significantly revamped: each wave will now spawn a wider variety of monsters, and all exits will produce monsters, so players no longer need to adjust the positions of spawn points.
[*] More ranged attack effects have been added for monsters, creating even more stunning bullet patterns in the game.
[*] New levels with different characteristics and mechanics, including jungles and machinery!
[*] Two brand-new characters have been added: the Cybernetic and the Swordmaster, each with unique attack methods and growth styles!
[*] Before launch, dozens of new defense towers are expected to be added, enriching players' in-game strategies.
[*] A level difficulty system is also being considered to make levels more challenging while providing players with diverse gameplay experiences under different challenge mechanisms!
[/list]

Thank you all for your support! Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Discord[/url], and share your feedbacks with us!

notes.title: Devil Slot Machine - Development Progress Update #1
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2674970/_/
Hello everyone! Devil Slot Machine is still in intense development, and we welcome you all to add the game to your wishlists↑

We can't wait to share some recent development achievements with you all! Here are the specifics:

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new defense towers called "Angel Towers." They trigger various effects when refreshed in the shop.
[*] Introduced optional character "Angel." Angels can gain Hp by attacking glowing defense towers.
[*] Implemented character missions. Players can enhance a character's attack power by completing these missions.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addressed several effect bugs related to defense towers.
[*] Adjusted the logic of the bell mechanism; now it's not possible to ring the bell multiple times during each stage transition, preventing players from skipping specific stages directly.
[/list]

[h2]Improving[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a level skip button; now players can directly skip tutorial levels.
[*] Implemented construction guide effects; now when building defense towers, towers that are similar or relevant to the one being built will be highlighted.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted monster health values; reduced early-stage monster health and increased late-stage monster health.
[/list]

Free Demo available now! Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Discord[/url], and share your feedbacks with us!
